text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 10 · 黏土微缩 · 冬日积木温泉旅馆 · 雪白 / 赤陶 / 灰蓝.
Environment: Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Handmade clay and felt stop-motion miniature snowy mountain hot-spring inn, terracotta roof and rounded blue-gray walls, steam rising from an empty outdoor stone bath, soft white felt snow, amber windows, charming tactile craftsmanship, immersive small-scale scene without a display base, no toys shaped as characters.
Visual medium: clay miniature; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 10 · 黏土微缩 · 冬日积木温泉旅馆 · 雪白 / 赤陶 / 灰蓝. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions. IMPORTANT: Reference 2 ORIGINAL image determines artistic medium and color grading; keep watercolor / impasto painting / cel animation / clay miniature respectively. Reference 1 only determines spatial layout, NOT render style. Do not homogenize all scenes into photorealism.
